details.text: We light the tub before you arrive. You just walk up, step in and let go. Afterwards — a cold shower, a towel and a chair by the fire pit.

pricing.title: Booking

hero.title: Heat, steam and warm wood

details.title: About the sauna
details.text: We fire the stove for you — you only need to arrive on time. After the sauna we recommend a cold shower and a moment in the quiet lounge or by the hot tub.

pricing.title: Booking

related.title: Add the hot tub

about.title: About us
about.description: The Hotel Mergera story — why Mērsrags, who we are and what inspired us.

hero.title: Small place. Heart project.
hero.subtitle: Hotel Mergera is a family-run guesthouse — our way of sharing the quiet of Mērsrags and the Latvian sauna tradition.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Mērsrags has always been more than a seaside town for us — it's the kind of quiet that lets you hear yourself again after long working months. When we got the chance to buy this house near the lighthouse, we knew: we wanted others to find the feeling we did.

Over the past few years we've reworked the house — natural materials, calm design, no clutter. The heart of it is the sauna and the hot tub, both open all year. When winter outside hits −10 °C, you'll find +40 °C in here.

items.title: Personal hosting
items.text: You're not just another booking. Write to us directly and you'll get an answer — often before you've even sat down.

items.title: Natural materials
items.text: Wood, linen, stone — no plastic and no fake gloss.

items.title: Quiet
items.text: No TVs in shared areas, no background noise. Just the sea and the wind.
